rules.text: "selector" is a component prop: the caller selects one. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.

"show" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting true | false. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.

Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.
